component.name: Hazard3-Doom
component.description: Doom running on the Hazard3 RISC-V CPU in an ECP5 FPGA, including monitor firmware, a DoomGeneric application, FPGA board integrations, host-side upload/flashing tools, and supporting project assets.

externalReferences.comment: Repository release-audit manifest for redistributed binaries and DLLs.

properties.name: hazard3-doom:licensing-model
properties.value: Multi-license, per-file/per-component; see LICENSING.md and LICENSES/ notices.

properties.name: hazard3-doom:sbom-scope
properties.value: Source tree, pinned source submodules, known bundled third-party components, and redistributed convenience binaries.

properties.name: hazard3-doom:excluded-content
properties.value: DOOM IWAD/game data is not distributed by Hazard3-Doom and is not part of this SBOM.

properties.name: hazard3-doom:build-environment
properties.value: External build toolchains are not modeled here unless they are redistributed in the repository.

properties.name: hazard3-doom:sbom-generation-policy
properties.value: Do not invent missing versions or provenance. Regenerate for releases and replace unresolved fields when exact artifacts are known.
